verdict: No LIVE content is missing from the enumeration. Every live base card, evolution, hero, champion, and tower troop on the wiki today is covered by the 179-key snapshot + r1a/r1b/r1c ledger rows. The wiki has not changed since the 2026-08-25 enumeration (all master revids identical). Announced future content found (below) is a note, not a failure.

checks.question: any NEW BASE CARDS the 179-key snapshot lacks?
checks.method: fresh categorymembers walk of Troop/Building/Spell/Champion Cards (196 unique titles, same count as r1a) diffed both directions against snapshot keys; every unmatched title's page fetched and classified by RemovedContent/EventCard markers; new-card lines grepped out of Version History 2025+2026
checks.result: NONE MISSING. 122 live deck cards on the wiki, all 122 present in the snapshot. The 17 category titles absent from the snapshot are all EventCard or RemovedContent: Barbarian Launcher, Heal, Party Hut, Party Rocket, Raging Prince, Rocket Silo, Santa Hog Rider, Super Archers, Super Ice Golem, Super Knight, Super Lava Hound, Super Magic Archer, Super Mini P.E.K.K.A., Super Witch, Terry (removed champion, matches r1c), Warmth, Wizard Trio. Release-note cross-check: 2025 additions Vines, Spirit Empress, Boss Bandit, Berserker, Rune Giant and the only 2026 addition Ronin (6/7/2026) are all snapshot keys. The 15 snapshot base keys with no wiki card page are all spawned sub-units (lava_pups, golemite, phoenix_egg, royal_recruit, skarmy_general, ghost_souldier, decoy_goblin, goblin_barrel_decoy, bush_goblin, elixir_blob, elixir_golemite, goblin_brawler, lumberjack_ghost, mother_witch_hog, spirit_empress_air) -- expected, not stale entries.

checks.question: tower troops newer than Dagger Duchess / Royal Chef / Cannoneer?
checks.method: categorymembers of Category:Tower Troop Cards + Princess Towers page + Version History 2025/2026 grepped for tower-troop additions
checks.result: NO NEWER TOWER TROOPS. Full category roster: Tower Princess (default), Cannoneer, Dagger Duchess, Royal Chef, plus Baby Goblins. Baby Goblins is the spawned unit of the Goblin Queen Tower, a REMOVED temporary event tower (Goblin Queen Tower page carries {{RemovedContent|Page=true}}) -- categorized as a tower troop card but not selectable live content. No tower-troop addition appears in the 2025 or 2026 Version History.
checks.note_for_sim: the modeled trio + default Tower Princess is the complete live roster

checks.question: any evo/hero/champion in the newest release notes with no ledger row?
checks.method: every Balance|Add line in Version History (2026, newest entry 3-4/8/2026) and Version History/2025 (incl. the Heroes feature launch: 4 New Heroes Knight/Giant/Mini P.E.K.K.A./Musketeer) checked against r1a (42 evos), r1b (16 live + 2 announced heroes), r1c (8 live champions + Terry absent), registry.json
checks.result: FULLY COVERED. Newest release notes (3/8/2026): Berserker + Valkyrie heroes -> r1b/registry rows exist; Elite Barbarians evolution -> r1a/registry row exists (live, stub subpage, not yet categorized on the wiki -- the ledger is AHEAD of the category walk, which finds only 41 categorized evo subpages). All 12 heroes added across 2026 plus the 4 launch heroes from the 2025 feature launch = the 16 live r1b rows. No champion added since Boss Bandit (2025-04-07); Champion Cards category = 8 live + removed Terry, matching r1c. abilities/ has 24 yaml = 16 hero abilities + 8 champions, matching the live rosters.

checks.question: any THIRD variant class besides evolution/hero?
checks.method: allpages subpage-prefix probes over 14 representative cards (Knight, Musketeer, Valkyrie, Wizard, Mega Knight, Goblins, Giant, Archers, Boss Bandit, Skeleton King, Balloon, Berserker, Elite Barbarians, Battle Healer) + subpage titles appearing in the 4 card categories
checks.result: NO THIRD LADDER VARIANT CLASS. Only three subpage families exist: /Evolution, /Hero, and /Merge Tactics. Merge Tactics is a separate auto-battler game mode (golden elixir, traits, Rulers such as Echo Sage / Tomb Queen / Dagger Duchess) -- its variants never enter 1v1 ladder decks and are correctly out of scope for the sim. Tower troops are a distinct card CLASS (covered in check b), not a variant of a base card.
